## Recraft V4 API

Recraft V4 is an image generation model by Recraft, available on the Venice API as `recraft-v4`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Recraft V4 is Recraft's image model, known for high-quality output and precise text rendering. It suits design, branding and marketing work.

### Recraft V4 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `recraft-v4` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.05 / image |

### Recraft V4 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Recraft |
| Released | Feb 12, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 9:16, 2:3, 3:4, 4:5 |
| Prompt limit | 10,000 characters |

### How to use the Recraft V4 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "recraft-v4"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "recraft-v4",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
